title: a workflow saves an aggregate it creates before the loop that creates rows referencing it
note: Gate for D-PARENT-FIRST (docs/decisions).  Node, .NET, Java and Python saved the created parent only at the workflow's exit, so the first child insert failed on its foreign key; Elixir saved it in place.  The parent is saved before the first loop or branch that reads it and saves rows of its own.

apiCaller.//: The workflow command — the not-lifted workflow-route class.
